about_the_game:
Boom Cube is a creative 3D puzzle-elimination game that reimagines classic Tetris mechanics in a fully spatial environment. Set on a 10×10 cube-based platform, players control block groups made of 4 smaller cubes. These blocks fall, move, rotate, and transform to fit into the grid and trigger horizontal or vertical line eliminations for high scores.

Players can use the keyboard to control horizontal movement (along the X and Z axes), rotate block shapes, and freely change the camera view—drag to rotate 360°, tilt up or down—to analyze the 3D structure and plan optimal placements. Each falling block follows one of three spatial rules: aligned along the X, Y, or Z axis, creating different dimensional challenges.

Core Gameplay Features:

  • Fully Rotatable 3D View: Rotate the scene freely to change the gameplay perspective and make the smartest spatial decisions.

  • Smart Falling & Chain Elimination: Eliminate lines of 10 blocks in any direction to trigger satisfying chain reactions and bonus points.

  • Center-Priority Scoring: Blocks placed closer to the center score higher—5, 4, 3, 2, 1 points from inner to outer—rewarding precision and planning.

  • Chain Drop Bonus: After a row clears, blocks above fall down. Each falling level earns an extra +2 points.

  • Three Block Structures: Falling pieces align along X, Y, or Z axes—offering varied and dynamic spatial challenges.

  • Rhythmic Themes: The drop speed and block patterns adjust to the background music’s rhythm, offering a fresh audiovisual experience.

Game Modes:

  • Endless Score Mode: The game ends when blocks stack above 10 layers—push your limits to survive and score higher.

  • Level Challenge Mode: Complete specific goals or score thresholds to unlock more difficult stages and gameplay variations.

Who It’s For:

Whether you’re a veteran puzzle fan or a newcomer seeking fast-paced spatial challenges, Boom Cube delivers a refreshing twist on elimination gameplay with rhythm, logic, and 3D flair.

short_description: Boom Cube is a 3D puzzle game inspired by Tetris. Move, rotate, and drop block groups onto a 10x10 grid. Clear lines, trigger combos, and earn higher scores the closer to the center. Fast-paced, rhythmic, and full of spatial strategy.
